title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain Case Western Reserve University
description: From 24-hour study marathons at Kelvin Smith Library to midnight pizza at Rascal House, these late-night destinations define the after-hours experience for CWRU students.

cards.title: Overnight Study at KSL
cards.subtitle: The 24/5 Academic Hub
cards.notes: Access the first floor 24 hours a day from Sunday through Thursday during the regular semester for late-night research and group work.
cards.short_summary: The primary library at CWRU offers 24-hour access to its first floor for students during the academic week.
cards.evidence_claim: The first floor of Kelvin Smith Library is open for overnight study access to CWRU students with active IDs Sunday through Thursday during the regular semester.
cards.source_title: Hours | Kelvin Smith Library - Case Western Reserve University
cards.access_notes: Open 24 hours Sunday through Thursday; requires valid CWRU ID for entry after 8:00 PM.

cards.title: Midnight Slices at Rascal House
cards.subtitle: University Circle Pizza Staple
cards.notes: Order a late-night pizza or wings at this Euclid Avenue favorite, which stays open until 2:00 AM or later most nights of the week.
cards.short_summary: A long-standing local pizza chain serving University Circle with late-night delivery and carry-out options.
cards.evidence_claim: Rascal House Pizza in University Circle is open until 2:00 AM Monday through Saturday and 1:30 AM on Sunday.
cards.access_notes: Open until 2:00 AM Mon-Sat and 1:30 AM Sun.

cards.title: Late Night at The Den
cards.subtitle: North Campus Dining Hub
cards.notes: Visit this North Campus diner for late-night meal swipes, featuring a menu of burgers, sandwiches, and breakfast items until 2:00 AM.
cards.short_summary: A student-focused diner on North Campus providing late-night meal options and a social atmosphere.
cards.evidence_claim: The Den (North Campus Diner) offers late-night dining services, typically operating until 2:00 AM for students on meal plans.
cards.source_title: On-Campus Locations | Dining Services - Case Western Reserve University
cards.access_notes: Open late night until 2:00 AM; accepts meal swipes and CaseCash.

cards.title: Warm Cookie Delivery
cards.subtitle: Uptown Dessert Run
cards.notes: Satisfy a late-night sweet tooth with warm cookies delivered to your dorm or picked up at the Uptown location until 1:00 AM.
cards.short_summary: A popular bakery specializing in late-night cookie delivery and walk-up service near the CWRU campus.
cards.evidence_claim: Insomnia Cookies in University Circle is open until 12:00 AM Sun-Wed and 1:00 AM Thu-Sat.
cards.access_notes: Open until 1:00 AM on weekends; delivery available to campus dorms.

cards.title: South Campus Late Night
cards.subtitle: Fribley Dining Hall
cards.notes: Head to Fribley Commons on South Campus for late-night dining options, a convenient stop for students living in the Carlton Road area.
cards.short_summary: The primary dining hall for South Campus residents, offering extended hours for late-night meals.
cards.evidence_claim: Fribley Commons provides 'Fribley Late Night' dining services for students during the academic semester.
cards.source_title: On-Campus Locations | Dining Services - Case Western Reserve University
cards.access_notes: Late-night hours typically run until 11:00 PM or midnight depending on the semester schedule.

cards.title: Jolly Scholar Karaoke
cards.subtitle: Thwing Center Social Spot
cards.notes: Enjoy burgers and milkshakes at this on-campus restaurant, which hosts karaoke and remains open until 2:00 AM on Thursday nights.
cards.short_summary: An on-campus gastropub and brewery located in the Thwing Center that serves as a late-night social hub.
cards.evidence_claim: The Jolly Scholar is open until 2:00 AM on Thursdays and 12:00 AM on Fridays.
cards.access_notes: Open until 2:00 AM on Thursdays; under-21 safe for dining.

cards.title: The Tink After Hours
cards.subtitle: 24-Hour Student Center
cards.notes: Utilize the open lounge spaces and study areas in 'The Tink' at any hour, as the building remains accessible to students 24/7.
cards.short_summary: The central student union at CWRU, offering 24-hour access to common areas and study spaces.
cards.evidence_claim: Tinkham Veale University Center is open 24 hours a day for student access.
cards.source_title: Visit Us | Student Centers - Case Western Reserve University
cards.access_notes: Open 24/7; requires CWRU ID for entry during late-night hours.

cards.title: Leutner Late Night
cards.subtitle: North Campus Meal Swipes
cards.notes: Grab a late-night snack or meal at Leutner Commons, the primary dining destination for students living on the North Residential Area.
cards.short_summary: A major dining hall on North Campus that offers extended late-night hours for students.
cards.evidence_claim: Leutner Commons offers 'Late Night' dining options for students, typically operating until 10:00 PM or later.
cards.source_title: On-Campus Locations | Dining Services - Case Western Reserve University
cards.access_notes: Late-night hours vary by semester; check the Transact mobile app for current daily schedules.

cards.title: Uptown Ice Cream Run
cards.subtitle: Local Cleveland Favorite
cards.notes: Visit the Uptown shop for a scoop of locally-made ice cream, open until 10:30 PM daily for a post-study treat.
cards.short_summary: A beloved Cleveland ice cream parlor with a location in the heart of the Uptown district near campus.
cards.evidence_claim: Mitchell's Homemade Ice Cream in University Circle is open daily from 11:00 AM to 10:30 PM.

cards.title: Spartie Mart Snacks
cards.subtitle: Campus Convenience Store
cards.notes: Pick up snacks, drinks, and essentials at this on-campus convenience store, which offers extended evening hours for students.
cards.short_summary: A university-run convenience store providing quick food and household items to the campus community.
cards.evidence_claim: Spartie Mart is a campus convenience location that accepts CaseCash and offers evening hours.
cards.source_title: On-Campus Locations | Dining Services - Case Western Reserve University
cards.access_notes: Hours typically extend until 11:00 PM or midnight during the semester.
